conditions: Apple M1 / local Chromium at 1440x1000, unthrottled, local HTTP, browser cache disabled at startup; one game measurement at a time. Same preexisting nine sample routes and weather modes.
limits: Initial revised run included a 1433.4 ms first-drive pause; mean is reported including it, not silently discarded.
The unchanged-package repeat tests whether the pause persists. It does not prove its cause or guarantee no future hitch.

The nine samples cover short First Avenue northbound plus Seventh east/west in three weather modes. They are not a full St. Marks frame-rate benchmark; the separate complete-route tests check traversal and contacts.
Local startup and a single machine are not a public-network or device-wide performance guarantee.
